note: Country adds a 'country' field type (stores a 2-letter ISO 3166 code), widgets country_default (select) / country_autocomplete, formatters country_default (name) / country_iso_code (raw code), and a per-field 'selectable_countries' setting. No external services. All medium/hard cases are grounded in live Field/entity-display config on the Article content type, verifiable with drush php:eval: introspection reads back a field's selectable_countries and its configured widget; execution creates a restricted country field and switches a field's formatter to country_iso_code.

evals.prompt: What field type does the Drupal 'country' contrib module provide, and what exactly is stored in the database for it?
evals.expected_output: It provides a field type with id 'country' whose stored value is a 2-character ISO 3166 alpha-2 country code (column 'value', length 2); the human-readable name is resolved from core's country_manager service.

evals.prompt: The country module ships two field formatters. What are their machine ids and how does each display the value?
evals.expected_output: country_default renders the localized country name (the default formatter); country_iso_code renders the raw ISO code (e.g. US).

evals.prompt: With the country module, how do I limit a country field so editors can only pick from a specific subset of countries? Name the field setting.
evals.expected_output: Set the field's 'selectable_countries' setting (a list of ISO codes) on the storage/field settings; an empty value offers all countries. The effective list is resolved by the country.field.manager service.

evals.prompt: The Article content type on this site has a country field whose choices are restricted to a subset of countries. Inspect the live field configuration and tell me the machine name of the field and which ISO country codes it allows.
evals.expected_output: The field is field_ctry_known (type country); its selectable_countries setting is [US, GB, FR].

evals.prompt: One country field on the Article content type uses a type-ahead widget rather than a dropdown. Inspect the live default form display and tell me the machine name of the widget it uses and the placeholder text configured on it.
evals.expected_output: field_ctry_widget uses the country_autocomplete widget with placeholder 'Start typing a country'.

evals.prompt: On the Article content type, add a Country field named field_ctry_task (field type from the country module) and configure it so editors may only choose Canada (CA) and Mexico (MX). Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Create a field storage (entity_type node, field_name field_ctry_task, type country) and a field on node.article with settings.selectable_countries = ['CA','MX'], then save. verify checks the field's type is country and its selectable_countries equals [CA, MX].

evals.prompt: The Article content type has a country field field_ctry_fmt that currently displays the full country name. Change its default display so it shows the raw two-letter ISO country code instead, and apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_view_display.node.article.default set the field_ctry_fmt component formatter type to country_iso_code (instead of country_default) and save.
